title: The opening
copy: i've been working on this for a whole year now. because everyone in this space is stuck on the same problem.
note: Claude's opening retained byte-for-byte. The one-year timeline remains a copy review question.
original_copy:
i've been working on this for a whole year now.
because everyone in this space is stuck on the same problem.

title: Two businesses
copy: you're already good at what you do. trading. tiktok shop. whatever it is. now you want to teach it. but a mentorship is a business of its own: content, an offer, a way to sell it. so now you're learning two businesses at once.
note: Proposed rewrite: removes the unsupported comparison of mentorship earnings with craft earnings. Whole café photo; type supplies the comparison.
original_copy:
you're already good at what you do.
trading. tiktok shop. whatever it is.
and you know a mentorship can make you more than the thing itself.
but info is a whole business on its own.
so now you're learning two businesses at once.

title: The whole chain
copy: content. traffic. a page. sales calls. a team. cash in the bank. that's the whole chain. knowing your craft doesn't teach you how to run all of this. that's the part you have to build.
note: Proposed rewrite: retains the chain, removes the KPI put-down; follows Claude’s numbered-list composition.
original_copy:
content. traffic. a page. sales calls. a team. cash in the bank.
that's the whole chain.
most people have never run it.
some don't even know what a kpi is.
and that's fine. nobody teaches you this part.

title: Where it breaks
copy: it breaks somewhere: you want to post, but don't know what to say. you post, but nobody's watching. people watch, but you don't know where to send them. calls get booked, but you can't see what's happening after. one missing step is enough to stop the next one.
note: Proposed concise diagnosis; no additional numerical claims. Keeps the founder work-photo background.
original_copy:
it breaks somewhere:
- you want to post, but you don't know what to say
- you know what to say, but nobody's watching
- people are watching, but you don't know where to send them
- calls are booked, but you can't tell who's closing and who isn't

title: The conversation gets lost
copy: you post something. a couple of people dm you. some conversations go nowhere. others never make it onto a call. and when someone does buy, you can't tell which post brought them in.
note: Proposed rewrite: removes “lose half” and the invented 40/20/8 chart. A conversation path explains the leak without posing as measured data.
original_copy:
you post something.
a couple of people dm you.
you lose half of them in the chat.
the ones who book don't close.
and you have no idea which post brought any of them in.

title: Try harder
copy: so you try harder. more posts. more tools. another chatgpt tab at 2am. you start copying what the big names do. their format takes over. your own voice gets harder to hear. meanwhile, the thing that pays you gets less of your time.
note: Illustrative browser, not a real chat or testimonial. Carries Claude’s late-night artifact direction without the pile of tool labels.
original_copy:
so you try harder.
more posts. more tools. another chatgpt tab at 2am.
you start copying what the big names do.
and you end up promoting their format instead of building your own.
meanwhile the thing that actually pays you gets less of your time.

title: The cost
copy: eventually, you go back to the business that pays the bills. the mentorship gets pushed to next week. then next month. you need a way to build it alongside what you already do.
note: Proposed rewrite: replaces the generic plateau graph and blanket absolution with the practical two-business cost. Deliberately quiet type-led pause.
original_copy:
that's where most people plateau.
then they pick the main business, because that's what keeps food on the table.
and the info side dies quietly.
none of that is your fault.

title: Your own voice
copy: you can still bring something new. your experience. your way of explaining it. the problems you see every day. you don't need to be first. you need to sound like you. that gives the content a direction.
note: Proposed rewrite: drops universal niche rankings/monthly entrant claims. Keeps the approved quote as the dominant visual, with the walking photo whole.
original_copy:
here's what most people miss.
the top of every niche is 3 or 4 names.
but new people break in every single month.
not because they're bigger. because they bring something new.
people always want a new face with a new idea.
"you don't need to be first. you need to sound like you."

title: The reveal — video storyboard
copy: so i built the bridge. you shouldn't have to give up what you're good at to build a mentorship. pulsify brings your content, offer, funnel and sales into one place, and we work through it with you.
note: Static storyboard, not finished video. Founder footage remains required. Mark used here and in Claude’s opening only.
original_copy:
On screen: so i built the bridge.
Spoken (~25s): you shouldn't have to give up what you're good at to build an info business. so i took everything i've learned about content, funnels and sales, and built one place that runs it from the first view to the cash in your account. what to post. how to say it. where to send people. who's ready to buy. who's closing. this is pulsify.

title: Content in your voice
copy: now you sit down and you know what to make. content built around your voice, your offer and the people you want to reach. and we work through it with you.
note: Actual saved Voice crop, labelled Example workspace; no new results. Proposed copy makes the service role explicit.
original_copy:
now you sit down and you already know what to make.
it's written in your voice, so you don't sound like everyone else.
the people who see it land somewhere that sells.
and we work through it with you.

title: The sales side
copy: then the sales side. you can see what happens after a call gets booked. calls, closes, cash collected. the numbers your team works against.
note: Story-scale illustrative arrangement of shipped sales metric fields, explicitly labelled; no invented performance values or fake conversations.
original_copy:
then the sales side.
you see who's closing. who's not.
who's hitting their calls. who's hitting your numbers.
no more guessing what happened on a call.
no scripts to write yourself.

title: See what converts
copy: tracked links connect content to leads and matched payments. you can see what turns into a sale. so the next post starts with something to learn from.
note: Actual saved funnel UI, cropped into readable stage groups. Proposed copy separates tracked attribution from identifying every anonymous viewer. Removes sample $63,000 headline.
original_copy:
and every post is tracked. who watched, who clicked, who booked, who paid.
"you never post blind again."

title: Built through the work
copy: none of this was built overnight. the research. the frameworks. the build. the testing. brought into one place, so you can keep doing what you're good at.
note: Proposed rewrite: preserves documented work while removing “every framework was tested first”, which would imply universal business validation.
original_copy:
none of this was built overnight.
every framework was tested first.
then turned into one place that does the heavy lifting, so you can keep doing what you're good at.

title: The close
copy: right now, it's for the people i work with. we build the business with you. pulsify is part of that. it's getting sharper every week. and i'm not stopping until this is a seven-figure company.
note: Keeps founder ambition, clarifies service-plus-system access; no CTA or scarcity.
original_copy:
right now it's only for the people i work with.
it's getting sharper every week.
and i'm not stopping until this is a seven-figure company.
